profile.summary: FEV Tutor is a company that provides live, one-on-one online tutoring to K-12 students. It partners with schools and districts, using a network of trained tutors, and offers program design, data analytics and ongoing assessments. Its programs are designed to meet Level Two standards under the Every Student Succeeds Act, the federal education law.
